{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Implement the increment within the existing Spring Cloud Data Flow, Spring Cloud Stream, and deployer extension points rather than introducing a parallel runtime or module architecture.",
    "Use the existing shell command framework and runtime metadata model for the runtime-info command, exposing available host, port, state, and related deployment details.",
    "Implement YARN deployment through the existing Hadoop/YARN integration and deployer abstraction, with configuration supplied through standard Data Flow deployment properties.",
    "Port the identified Spring XD file source module to the Spring Cloud Stream module conventions, preserving compatible source semantics while replacing XD-specific integration points.",
    "Split SPI deployers into independently buildable and bundleable artifacts while retaining a parent build for shared dependency and lifecycle management.",
    "Replace XDRuntimeException usages with appropriate standard or project-specific exception types, preserving meaningful error categories and user-facing diagnostics.",
    "Upgrade the GemFire sink to the latest compatible release and validate compatibility with the supported Spring, Spring Cloud Stream, and GemFire APIs.",
    "Deliver SFTP as an out-of-the-box source module, including module metadata, executable artifacts, Maven publication, and module-list registration.",
    "Use automated CI pipelines to build, test, package, and perform representative Data Flow and family integration checks on every commit.",
    "Favor backward-compatible configuration and command behavior unless the existing XD implementation prevents compatibility."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The increment covers one normal development cycle by one software developer familiar with Java, Spring, Maven, Hadoop/YARN, and CI systems.",
    "The existing repositories, build infrastructure, deployment abstractions, and test harnesses are available and can be modified without major platform migration.",
    "The exact file module in U3 is assumed to be one existing Spring XD file source module with a bounded codebase and no proprietary dependencies.",
    "A usable Hadoop/YARN test environment or equivalent integration-test environment is available; effort for provisioning a new production-grade cluster is excluded.",
    "YARN deployment requires integration with existing Data Flow deployment APIs and configuration, not implementation of a new Hadoop scheduler.",
    "The latest GemFire sink release is assumed to be API-compatible or require only minor adapter changes.",
    "SFTP functionality is based on an existing or commonly supported Spring Integration SFTP implementation; development of a new SFTP protocol library is excluded.",
    "CI work includes pipeline configuration, test execution, artifact publication checks, and representative integration validation, but excludes procurement or administration of new CI infrastructure.",
    "Code review, defect correction, documentation, packaging, and release verification are included in the estimates.",
    "Estimates are work-hours and represent the single most likely effort, not elapsed calendar time."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Increment analysis and technical design",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing Data Flow, XD, module, deployer, build, and CI structures; map each user story to affected components; define compatibility boundaries, test strategy, and implementation sequencing.",
      "most_likely_effort": 32
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Runtime information shell command",
      "activity_description": "Implement the shell command for runtime information, connect it to runtime and deployment metadata, format host, port, state, and related details, and add unit and command-level tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 48
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "YARN data-flow deployment support",
      "activity_description": "Implement or complete the YARN deployer integration, map Data Flow deployment properties to YARN configuration, handle application submission and lifecycle operations, provide diagnostics, and add unit and integration coverage.",
      "most_likely_effort": 180
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Port XD file module to the Data Flow repository",
      "activity_description": "Move the file source module from XD into the target repository, adapt packaging and Spring Cloud Stream contracts, remove XD-specific dependencies, configure metadata, and add functional tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 64
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Individually bundle SPI deployers",
      "activity_description": "Refactor the build lifecycle so SPI deployers can be built and packaged independently, update module boundaries and dependency management, preserve aggregate builds, and verify generated artifacts.",
      "most_likely_effort": 96
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Remove XDRuntimeException dependencies",
      "activity_description": "Locate and replace XD-specific runtime exception usage, select suitable exception types, update propagation and error handling, remove obsolete dependencies, and add regression tests for affected failure paths.",
      "most_likely_effort": 40
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Upgrade GemFire sink",
      "activity_description": "Update the GemFire sink dependency and integration code to the latest compatible release, adjust configuration or API usage, validate startup and message delivery, and update tests and module metadata.",
      "most_likely_effort": 32
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Deliver SFTP source as an out-of-the-box module",
      "activity_description": "Implement or port the SFTP source, add configuration and module metadata, include it in the standard module list, produce and publish Maven artifacts, and verify operation with an SFTP test endpoint.",
      "most_likely_effort": 72
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Complete Data Flow and family CI pipelines",
      "activity_description": "Identify remaining CI gaps, add build and test jobs for Data Flow and related modules, configure artifact and integration-test stages, enable execution on each commit, and document pipeline prerequisites and failure diagnostics.",
      "most_likely_effort": 128
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-component integration and regression validation",
      "activity_description": "Run the complete build and representative end-to-end scenarios covering shell runtime information, YARN deployment, source modules, deployer packaging, GemFire delivery, SFTP ingestion, and compatibility regressions; fix issues found during validation.",
      "most_likely_effort": 96
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Documentation, release preparation, and final verification",
      "activity_description": "Update user and developer documentation, command and configuration references, release notes, dependency and artifact information, perform final clean-build verification, and prepare the increment for delivery.",
      "most_likely_effort": 32
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 820
  }
}

Implement YARN deployment through the existing Hadoop/YARN integration and deployer abstraction, with configuration supplied through standard Data Flow deployment properties.
Port the identified Spring XD file source module to the Spring Cloud Stream module conventions, preserving compatible source semantics while replacing XD-specific integration points.
Split SPI deployers into independently buildable and bundleable artifacts while retaining a parent build for shared dependency and lifecycle management.
Replace XDRuntimeException usages with appropriate standard or project-specific exception types, preserving meaningful error categories and user-facing diagnostics.
Upgrade the GemFire sink to the latest compatible release and validate compatibility with the supported Spring, Spring Cloud Stream, and GemFire APIs.
Deliver SFTP as an out-of-the-box source module, including module metadata, executable artifacts, Maven publication, and module-list registration.
Use automated CI pipelines to build, test, package, and perform representative Data Flow and family integration checks on every commit.
Favor backward-compatible configuration and command behavior unless the existing XD implementation prevents compatibility.
assumptions: The increment covers one normal development cycle by one software developer familiar with Java, Spring, Maven, Hadoop/YARN, and CI systems.
The existing repositories, build infrastructure, deployment abstractions, and test harnesses are available and can be modified without major platform migration.
The exact file module in U3 is assumed to be one existing Spring XD file source module with a bounded codebase and no proprietary dependencies.
A usable Hadoop/YARN test environment or equivalent integration-test environment is available; effort for provisioning a new production-grade cluster is excluded.
YARN deployment requires integration with existing Data Flow deployment APIs and configuration, not implementation of a new Hadoop scheduler.
The latest GemFire sink release is assumed to be API-compatible or require only minor adapter changes.

CI work includes pipeline configuration, test execution, artifact publication checks, and representative integration validation, but excludes procurement or administration of new CI infrastructure.
Code review, defect correction, documentation, packaging, and release verification are included in the estimates.
Estimates are work-hours and represent the single most likely effort, not elapsed calendar time.
